title: Learning hub — small-business funding resources
metaDescription: Plain-language guides on SBA loans, document prep, and choosing the right financing. Learn how business funding works and move from education into comparison when you are ready.
summary: The resources hub introduces educational funding content and routes visitors into structured articles connected to the route manifest.

hero.title: Clear guides to funding your business.
hero.lead: No jargon, no hype — just plain-language explanations of how small-business financing works and how to choose what fits.

quickAnswer.definition: is Fund44's structured article collection for financing education, document preparation, and comparison guidance.

whoItFits.heading: Who this hub fits
items: Borrowers researching financing before starting the preview flow.
Users comparing SBA and non-SBA paths in plain language.
Visitors who want educational content connected to the main funding routes.

whenItMayNotFit.heading: When this hub may not fit
items: Users who want a direct product explanation rather than a guide article.
Borrowers looking for legal, tax, or provider-specific advice.

typicalDocuments.heading: Typical documents discussed across the hub
items: Purchase agreement or letter of intent for acquisitions

howFund44Fits.heading: How Fund44 fits
howFund44Fits.summary: The learning hub supports organic and comparison intent by connecting educational articles to product and preview routes.
bullets: Keeps article copy in structured content instead of template literals.
Connects each article to canonical slugs and related pages.
Supports future citation and freshness workflows without changing route ownership.

commonQuestions.question: Are these articles financial or legal advice?
commonQuestions.answer: No. The learning hub is educational content intended to explain financing concepts in plain language.

commonQuestions.question: How do these articles connect to funding options?
commonQuestions.answer: Each article links to related program pages and the financing overview so you can move from education into comparison and preview when you are ready.

ctaBanner.heading: Ready to move from reading to matching?
ctaBanner.subheading: Fund44 is designed for a faster process, with routing explanations, one document checklist, document reuse where supported in the workflow, status tracking, and offer comparison when those steps are available in the experience. Exact timing, available paths, and workflow details can vary by provider and by business profile.
